title: Package options reference

Debug : raw mode can expose cookies, authorization headers, codes, state values, client IP addresses options(shinyOAuth.audit_digest_key = ...) – shared key least 32 bytes HMAC-SHA256 digests used audit/OTel attributes. Invalid configured keys cause error; default, ‘shinyOAuth’ generates random per-process key configured options(shinyOAuth.otel_tracing_enabled = FALSE) – disable ‘shinyOAuth’ OpenTelemetry span creation async trace-context propagation. title: Package options reference
text: options(shinyOAuth.leeway = 30) – default clock skew leeway (seconds) ID token exp/iat/nbf checks state payload issued_at future check options(shinyOAuth.max_id_token_lifetime = 86400) – maximum ID token lifetime seconds (exp - iat). additional package check beyond OIDC expiry check. Default 86400 (24 hours). Set Inf disable check options(shinyOAuth.allowed_non_https_hosts = c("localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1", "[::1]")) - allows hosts use http:// non-OIDC URL checks; relax OIDC discovery options(shinyOAuth.allow_insecure_oidc_loopback = TRUE) – development-opt-OIDC issuer endpoint URLs HTTP loopback origins; production OIDC metadata URLs must use HTTPS options(shinyOAuth.allowed_hosts = c()) – non‑empty, restricts accepted hosts whitelist options(shinyOAuth.allow_hs = TRUE) – opt‑HMAC validation ID tokens (HS256/HS384/HS512). Requires strictly server‑side client_secret options(shinyOAuth.client_assertion_ttl = 120L) – lifetime seconds JWT client assertions used client_secret_jwt private_key_jwt token endpoint authentication. Finite values 60 seconds coerced 60 seconds, finite values 300 seconds clamped 300 seconds, NA non-finite values fall back 120-second default options(shinyOAuth.state_fail_delay_ms = 0) – delay milliseconds state parsing decryption failures. Defaults 0 (delay). positive number sets fixed delay; two numbers, c(10, 30), set bounds randomized delay. Positive delays sleep synchronously block Shiny worker, including initial state validation async = TRUE. delay adds timing noise provide constant-time validation. Note allowed_hosts: patterns support globs (*, ?). Using catch‑like "*" matches host effectively disables endpoint host restrictions (scheme rules still apply). Avoid unless truly intend accept host; prefer pinning domain(s), e.g., c(".example.com").

title: Package options reference
text: default, ‘shinyOAuth’ blocks certain security-critical parameters passed via extra_auth_params, extra_token_params, extra_token_headers. helps prevent accidental misconfiguration break state binding, PKCE, client authentication. Set callback format oauth_client(response_mode = ...). specific, advanced use case need override one blocked parameters, can unblock using following options: options(shinyOAuth.unblock_auth_params = c("redirect_uri")) – allows replacing specified authorization URL parameters. title: Discover and create an OpenID Connect (OIDC) OAuthProvider — oauth_provider_oidc_discover
text: issuer OIDC issuer base URL (including scheme), e.g., "https://login.example.com". standard discovery-document URL ending /.well-known/openid-configuration also accepted normalized back issuer base URL validation fetch. name Optional friendly provider name. Defaults issuer hostname use_pkce Logical, whether use PKCE provider. Defaults TRUE. Public clients require PKCE. Setting FALSE also prevents automatic selection public-client authentication; confidential-client method must available explicitly configured instead. use_nonce Logical, whether use OIDC nonce. Defaults TRUE id_token_validation Logical, whether validate ID tokens automatically provider. Defaults TRUE token_auth_style Authentication style token requests: "header" (client_secret_basic), "body" (client_secret_post), "public" (public client; send client_id ). alias "none" also accepted "public". NULL (default), inferred conservatively discovery. PKCE enabled provider advertises support public clients via none, discovery selects "public". Otherwise, helper prefers "header" (client_secret_basic) available, "body" (client_secret_post). JWT methods ("client_secret_jwt", "private_key_jwt") mTLS methods ("tls_client_auth", "self_signed_tls_client_auth") must selected explicitly. See oauth_provider() supported methods credentials. allowed_algs Character vector allowed ID token signing algorithms. Defaults broad set common algorithms, including RSA (RS*), ECDSA (ES*), EdDSA. discovery document advertises supported algorithms, intersection advertised caller-provided algorithms used avoid runtime mismatches. overlap, discovery fails configuration error (fallback). allowed_token_types Character vector allowed token types access tokens issued provider. Defaults 'Bearer' jwks_host_issuer_match TRUE (default), enforce JWKS host discovered provider matches issuer host exactly. providers serve JWKS different host, set jwks_host_allow_only exact hostname instead disabling . Disabling (FALSE) recommended unless also pin JWKS via jwks_host_allow_only jwks_pins. issuer_match Character scalar controlling strictly validate discovery document's issuer input issuer. "url" (default): require issuer used discovery match exactly normalizing full discovery-document input back issuer base URL, including trailing slash (recommended). Reserves refresh_token parameter name extra_token_params prevent duplicate refresh-token parameters token refresh requests. oauth_provider_oidc_discover() now: Fails fast metadata advertises PKCE methods omits S256. shinyOAuth keeps S256 default allows downgrade plain pass pkce_method = "plain" explicitly. Fails fast discovery document omits jwks_uri selected policy still needs signing keys, including id_token_validation = TRUE, nonce-enabled OIDC flows, signed UserInfo JWT validation. misconfigurations now fail provider setup instead later JWKS fetch. Maps token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported = ["none"] distinct public token auth style never sends client_secret, even oauth_client() picks one OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. oauth_provider_oidc() now trims trailing slashes base_url deriving endpoint URLs configured issuer, avoiding valid ID tokens rejected strict OIDC iss comparison helper configured URL like https://issuer.example/. oauth_provider_microsoft() longer drops Microsoft alias tenants OAuth 2.0 plus userinfo identity default. common organizations now validate ID tokens using Microsoft’s tenant-independent issuer signing-key issuer rules, consumers now validates stable consumer tenant issuer. validate_id_token() now properly rejects auth_time claims set future (beyond leeway). title: shinyOAuth 0.4.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-02-14 ‘mirai’ & async backend improvements: Warnings messages emitted async workers (e.g., missing expires_in token response) now captured re-emitted main process appear R console. includes conditions user-supplied trace_hook / audit_hook functions: warnings, messages, errors (surfaced warnings) propagate back main thread. Replay can disabled via options(shinyOAuth.replay_async_conditions = FALSE). Async callback flow longer serializes full client object (including potentially non-serializable custom state_store / JWKS cache backends) worker context. state_store (already consumed main thread) replaced lightweight serializable dummy dispatch. client still fails serialization, flow falls back synchronous execution explicit warning instead opaque runtime error. reduced serialization overhead towards async workers using certain functions package namespace directly. Detect active daemons via mirai::daemons_set() instead mirai::status(). Falls back mirai::info() older ‘mirai’ versions lack mirai::daemons_set() (< 2.3.0). Configurable per-task timeout via options(shinyOAuth.async_timeout) (milliseconds); timed-‘mirai’ tasks automatically cancelled dispatcher. Default NULL (timeout). Async audit events now include mirai_error_type field. classifies mirai transport-level failures separately application-level errors. Prevent ‘mirai’ warning spam ‘stats’ maybe available workers. ID token validation (validate_id_token()): Now enforces RFC 7515 section 4.1.11 critical header parameter (crit) processing rules. Tokens containing unsupported critical extensions rejected shinyOAuth_id_token_error. current implementation supports critical extensions, crit presence triggers rejection. Now validates at_hash (Access Token hash) claim present ID token (per OIDC Core section 3.1.3.8 3.2.2.9). claim exists, access token binding verified; mismatch raises shinyOAuth_id_token_error. New id_token_at_hash_required property OAuthProvider (default FALSE) forces login fail ID token contain at_hash claim. Now validates, refreshed ID tokens, per OIDC Core section 12.2, iss aud claims original ID token’s values (just provider configuration) cover edge cases multi-tenant providers rotating issuer URIs. Enforced validated non-validated code paths. Now detects encrypted ID tokens (JWE compact serialization, 5 dot-separated segments) early raises clear shinyOAuth_id_token_error instead letting confusing alg/typ/parse failure propagate. Now validates auth_time claim max_age present extra_auth_params (OIDC Core section 3.1.2.1). Now enforces package-defined maximum ID token lifetime (exp - iat); tokens unreasonably long lifetimes rejected shinyOAuth_id_token_error. Configure via options(shinyOAuth.max_id_token_lifetime = <seconds>) (default 86400 24 hours). Set Inf disable check. Stricter state store usage: custom_cache() gains optional take parameter atomic get--delete. state_store_get_remove() prefers $take() available; falls back $get() + $remove() mandatory post-removal absence check (instead trusting $remove() return values). Non-cachem::cache_mem() stores without $take() now error default prevent TOCTOU replay attacks shared/multi-worker deployments. bypass error, operators must explicitly acknowledge risk setting options(shinyOAuth.allow_non_atomic_state_store = TRUE), downgrades error warning. OAuthClient validator now validates $take() signature present. $remove() return value longer relied upon fallback path; post-removal $get() absence check authoritative. Stricter JWKS cache handling: JWKS cache key now includes host-policy fields (jwks_host_issuer_match, jwks_host_allow_only). Previously, two provider configs issuer different host policies shared cache entry, allowing relaxed-policy provider populate cache strict-policy provider skip host validation cache hit. Cache entries now also store JWKS source host re-validate current provider policy read (defense--depth). Stricter URL validation: OAuthClient now rejects redirect URIs containing fragments (per RFC 6749, section 3.1.2); OAuthProvider now rejects issuer identifiers containing query fragment components, covering oauth_provider_oidc_discover() manual construction providers. Stricter state payload parsing: callback state now rejects embedded NUL bytes JSON decoding. Stricter response size validation: enforce max response body size outbound HTTP endpoints (token, introspection, userinfo, OIDC discovery, JWKS). Curl aborts transfer early Content-Length exceeds limit; post-download guard catches chunked responses. Default 1 MiB, configurable via options(shinyOAuth.max_body_bytes). OAuthProvider (S7 class): leeway validator now rejects non-finite values (Inf, -Inf, NaN). Previously passed validation silently coerced 0 runtime, effectively disabling clock-skew tolerance. Reserved OAuth parameter blocking extra_auth_params extra_token_params now case-insensitive trims whitespace. Vector inputs pkce_method URL parameters (auth_url, token_url, userinfo_url, introspection_url, revocation_url) now produce clear scalar-input errors instead cryptic coercion failures. OAuthClient (S7 class): Gains claims_validation property; client sends structured claims request parameter essential = TRUE entries, setting controls whether returned ID token /userinfo response checked essential claims (similar scope_validation). Gains required_acr_values property; enables client-side enforcement OIDC acr (Authentication Context Class Reference) claim. extra_token_headers now consistently applied revoke introspect requests, matching existing behavior token exchange refresh. Previously, provider integrations requiring custom headers across token endpoints partially fail revocation/introspection. Fixed incorrect warning client created Shiny case. Malformed client_assertion_alg client_assertion_audience values (e.g., character(0), multi-element vectors) now produce clear validation errors instead crashing base R subscript---bounds errors. Empty string "" client_assertion_audience now explicitly rejected instead silently treated “provided”. OAuthToken (S7 class): Gains read-id_token_claims property exposes decoded ID token JWT payload named list, surfacing OIDC claims (e.g., acr, amr, auth_time) without manual decoding. Gains id_token_validated property (logical) indicating whether ID token cryptographically verified OAuth flow. oauth_module_server(): Now surfaces error_uri provider error callbacks (RFC 6749, section 4.1.2.1). new $error_uri reactive field contains URI human-readable error page provider includes one; NULL otherwise. error_uri callback parameter also validated configurable size limit (e.g., options(shinyOAuth.callback_max_error_uri_bytes = 2048)). OAuth callback query cleanup now also applied early return paths internal function .process_query(), ensuring consistent cleanup. OAuth callback query size caps now enforced even user already authenticated. Previously, “token already present” branch .process_query() called .query_has_oauth_callback_keys() (parses query string) size validation, bypassing intended DoS guardrails. validate_untrusted_query_string() check now runs unconditionally top .process_query(). OAuth callback error responses (?error=...) now require valid state parameter. Missing/invalid/consumed state treated properly invalid_state error instead surfacing error ?error=... (set attacker). OAuth callback including iss query parameter now validate provider’s configured/discovered issuer callback processing (complementing existing ID token iss claim validation occurs post-exchange) (per RFC 9207). mismatch produces issuer_mismatch error audit event, defending authorization-server mix-attacks multi-provider scenarios. iss absent, current behavior retained (enforcement). handle_callback(): longer accepts decrypted_payload state_store_values bypass parameters. parameters intended internal use oauth_module_server()’s async path. can misused direct/custom callers bypass important security checks, moved internal-helper function (handle_callback_internal()). handle_callback()/refresh_token(): token response omits expires_in, warning now emitted per phase (exchange_code / refresh_token) operators know proactive token refresh trigger. Users can now also set finite default lifetime tokens via options(shinyOAuth.default_expires_in = <seconds>); unset, shinyOAuth now falls back 3600 seconds. get_userinfo() now supports JWT-encoded userinfo responses per OIDC Core, section 5.3.2. endpoint returns Content-Type: application/jwt, body decoded JWT. Verification fail-closed: signature verification always performed provider JWKS using provider’s allowed_algs, alg=none always rejected, unparseable headers, non-asymmetric algorithms, missing issuer/JWKS infrastructure raise errors. options(shinyOAuth.allow_unsigned_userinfo_jwt = TRUE) permits unsigned JWTs. New userinfo_signed_jwt_required property OAuthProvider (default FALSE) mandates userinfo endpoint returns application/jwt content-type subject verification. client_bearer_req() now validates target URL is_ok_host() attaching Bearer token. Relative URLs, plain HTTP non-loopback hosts, hosts outside options(shinyOAuth.allowed_hosts) rejected default. new check_url argument (default TRUE) allows opting check URL already validated. err_http() now extracts RFC 6749 section 5.2 structured error fields (error, error_description, error_uri) JSON error response bodies. fields surfaced error message bullets, attached condition object (oauth_error, oauth_error_description, oauth_error_uri), included trace/audit events. improves debugging token endpoint failures (e.g. invalid_grant, invalid_client) without changing existing control flow. OIDC claims parameter support (OIDC Core, section 5.5): OAuthClient oauth_client() now accept claims argument request specific claims userinfo Endpoint /ID token. Pass list structure (automatically JSON-encoded) pre-encoded JSON string. OIDC openid scope enforcement: provider issuer set (indicating OIDC) openid missing client’s scopes, build_auth_url() now auto-prepends emits one-time warning. OIDC discovery (oauth_provider_oidc_discover()) now prefers confidential auth methods (client_secret_basic, client_secret_post) none advertised token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported. Previously, mixed metadata (e.g. none + client_secret_basic) PKCE enabled silently select public-client posture ("body" without credentials). Scope validation now aligns RFC 6749, section 3.3 scope-token grammar (NQSCHAR = %x21 / %x23-5B / %x5D-7E). previous regex rejected valid ASCII characters !, #, $, =, @, ~, others. printable ASCII except space, double-quote, backslash now accepted. JWT helpers (build_client_assertion(), resolve_client_assertion_audience()) now defense--depth scalar guards malformed property values cause subscript errors runtime. Audit events: audit_token_refresh: replaced non-informative had_refresh_token field (always TRUE post-mutation) refresh_token_rotated (indicates whether provider returned new refresh token).

text: Token revocation: tokens can now revoked Shiny session ends. Maximum size may configured via options(); see section ‘Size caps’ vignette("usage", package = "shinyOAuth"). DoS protection: rate-limited JWKS refresh: forced JWKS cache refreshes (triggered unknown kid) now rate-limited prevent abuse. JWKS pinning: pinning now enforced signature verification: previously, jwks_pins jwks_pin_mode = "" verified least one key JWKS matched pin, signature verification still use matching key (pinned ). Now, signature verification restricted use keys whose thumbprints appear pin list, ensuring true key pinning rather presence-checks. use_shinyOAuth() now injects <meta name="referrer" content="-referrer"> default reduce leaking ?code=…&state=… via Referer header callback page. Can disabled use_shinyOAuth(inject_referrer_meta = FALSE). Sensitive outbound HTTP requests (token exchange/refresh, introspection, revocation, userinfo, OIDC discovery, JWKS) now default disable redirect following reject 3xx responses prevent bypassing host/HTTPS policies. Configurable via options(shinyOAuth.allow_redirect = TRUE). client_bearer_req() also gains follow_redirect, defaults FALSE, similarly control redirect behavior requests using bearer tokens. State now also consumed login failure paths (provider returns error also state). Callback URL parameters now also cleared login failure paths. OAuthProvider now requires absolute URLs (scheme + hostname) endpoint URLs. Provider fingerprint now includes userinfo_url introspection_url, reducing risk misconfiguration multiple providers share endpoints. state_payload_max_age property OAuthClient independent freshness validation state payload’s issued_at timestamp. Default client assertion JWT TTL reduced 5 minutes 120 seconds, reducing window replay attacks allowing clock skew.
